metadata.title: Alphabet Stock (GOOGL) Joins Dow Jones as Mag 7 Takeover Nears Completion<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Alphabet’s Addition to the Dow Makes Mag 7 Takeover Nearly Complete
Alphabet will replace Verizon Communications in the Dow Jones Industrial Average before the opening of trading on June 29—putting five of the Magnificent 7 into the benchmark.
